units.en: As a warlord, conquer all of China and Japan.

This ⟦0⟧ requires a Chinese Warlord to conquer all ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ cores not including the states of ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧, which are controlled by the European countries of the ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧ and ⟦11⟧. This achievement is possible if the Warlord usurps ⟦12⟧ because it is based on tag rather than name of country and the tag stays the same when changed to ⟦13⟧. States must be taken in peace conference (not merely controlled) and must be owned directly (not through puppets.)

Requisite cores include several islands in the Pacific (Iwo Jima, Minamitorishima, Saipan, Okinawa, Taiwan, Kuril Islands, and South Sakhalin). They do ⟦0⟧ include Japanese non-core island possessions (Palau, Caroline Islands, Marshall Islands) or Korea. Additionally, as of patch 1.17 with ⟦1⟧, one of the Chinese cores (Kham) starts in possession of ⟦2⟧.
Note: this guide was written before 1.17 and No Compromise, No Surrender

Follow the Cooperation With the Nationalists branch of the focus tree and make sure the warlord becomes ⟦0⟧. This will make all ⟦1⟧ divisions as the player's. By this time, ⟦2⟧ will be at war with the Chinese United Front. Defeating ⟦3⟧ will be similar to ⟦4⟧, however this achievement calls for the annexation of Japan. Research Naval Invasion tech and submarines to do that.

Once Japan is pushed out of Asia, do not accept their white peace. Kick out the ⟦0⟧ and declare war against them or follow the Chinese focus tree to ⟦1⟧. If this is not done, they will make a civil war against the Chinese United Front by stealing all of the land. Take the ⟦2⟧ to puppet the warlords. Make sure all the warlords are puppeted as it is the best possible outcome for that focus. Decrease their autonomy to annex them. As for ⟦3⟧, Naval invade when ready. If the Allies or Soviet have a large contribution, you can pre-empetively puppet Japan and annex it through the autonomy system. You get the achievements when Japan and all warlords are fully annexed.

The strongest warlord is the ⟦0⟧ due to their starting resources. Due to your early equipment deficits and lack of research capability but very high manpower, focus on getting as much of your manpower onto the field as quickly as possible. DON'T force the Xi'an incident or ⟦1⟧ could refuse and the Chinese United Front won't form at all - wait to join later. With your troops you can then join and help China against the ⟦2⟧ by placing defensive divisions on their coastline - you will need a high number to be able to repel better-equipped Japanese invasions. Go for Root Out Corruption, Power Struggle and ⟦3⟧. This will give you enough ⟦4⟧ to do Power Struggle propaganda in three states to Chiang's two and will quickly put you on top. Push the Japanese out of China and Korea, while building a fleet and/or air force to cross the Sea of Japan. The focus ⟦5⟧ gives a fixed 50% chance to puppet each of the warlords (even if they are in a different faction). You can then annex those who accept via decisions, and declare war against the ones who don't. ⟦6⟧ may pursue a civil war with you while you are still fighting the Japanese, and you may not be able to use the ⟦7⟧ focus against them once you are in a faction together. It is important to deal with them early, however, as if left to the late game they can join the Allies and this will force you to fight on multiple fronts with the ⟦8⟧.

Set historical focuses to Off as ⟦0⟧ and reload a few times to get the best outcome, where ⟦1⟧ doesn't try to annex you and ⟦2⟧ doesn't attack soon - or even at all. Get a research slot and rush Join the Republican Government. Then, DO NOT take any focuses for extra ⟦3⟧ income and start competing for the states. Thanks to extra PP, you can grow your presence in 2 states at once, and overtaking China should be possible in about a year or so. Once you become China, focus on subduing other Warlords, lest they join some non-Chinese faction and make things difficult. Remember to build infrastructure, railroads and supply hubs, as Chinese supply is mostly atrocious. Once you have the warlords puppeted or annexed, you can take on Japan - guard the coasts and use paratroopers to make the war relatively trivial. This approach is a bit RNG-dependent, but it shouldn't take more than 10 reloads at worst; just make sure to use the proper infantry templates and develop your industry accordingly.
⟦0⟧ is an other option, as it can immediately join the Comintern and the ⟦1⟧ will never take land in China.
